article.title: Palestinians are responding to Israel’s stranglehold on the West Bank’s economy by forgiving each other’s debts en masse
article.author: Qassam Muaddi
article.content: As Israel's financial strangulation of the Palestinian economy enters its third year, Palestinians are turning to each other — forgiving debts worth millions of shekels in a viral solidarity campaign that began with a schoolteacher's bounced check.
source_folders: 06_左派ニュース・社会主義戦略
